chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl al-Ashʿari, from his father, from Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about one who performed ruku' with an Imam whom he was following, then raised his head before the Imam. He said: He repeats his ruku' with him.

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the prayer leader being followed in congregational salat
key_terms.رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ: lifted his head from the bowing position
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he repeats or returns to the act

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he raises his head from ruku' before the Imam in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding congregational salat (prayer). If a follower raises his head from ruku' before the Imam, he should return and perform the ruku' again with the Imam, emphasizing proper conformity with the Imam in prayer.
